notes.title: Weightless & Sharkarma: Part 1 Now Available on ImmersiX!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329603/48be49abd83760f0872fe9ff8da4bc5ebd5f75b7.png[/img]


[h2]Hi everyone![/h2]

We’re excited to launch two immersive 6DoF experiences today on the ImmersiX App!

"[b]Weightless[/b]", a fully free VR experience that lets you drift through space in complete zero gravity. Move freely with six degrees of freedom, feel the vastness of space, and lose yourself in a stunningly immersive environment.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2771490/ImmersiX__Weightless_by_Arilena_Ara/

"[b]Sharkarma: Guardian of the Oceans (Part 1)[/b]", a cinematic VR movie that puts you at the center of an underwater survival thriller. A deep-sea expedition takes a deadly turn, and you’re caught in the middle. 

Now available in Early Access for $3.99, buy now and get Part 2 for free upon release in 2025.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2771480/ImmersiX__Sharkarma/

Explore more on ImmersiX – all available for free:
[list]
[*] "[b]Introduction to V-Nova PresenZ[/b]". Discover the revolutionary 6DoF volumetric video format behind our experiences. This guided intro will show you what makes PresenZ different - and why it’s the future of immersive content.
[*] "[b]Construct VR[/b]". Originally released in 2021, this stylized short drops you into a robotic world full of atmosphere and visual flair—a glimpse into the origins of our 6DoF storytelling.
[/list]

[b]Finally, we also updated the ImmersiX Player![/b]

To make your experience smoother, we've improved the ImmersiX Player with:
[list]
[*] Optimized file format for faster pre-loading, reducing wait times.
[*] Anonymous analytics to gather feedback on playback quality and enhance future performance.
[/list]
Explore, experience, and immerse yourself today!

[b]Useful Links:[/b]
ImmersiX Manual: https://docs.v-nova.com/immersix

Contact Us: https://docs.v-nova.com/immersix/contact-us

Privacy Policy: https://docs.v-nova.com/immersix/privacy-policy


[b]V-Nova Studios[/b]

notes.title: Patch notes / App updates 2025.03
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329603/2312cdc6b303ecd3369453ac60b0f97779f2b1af.png[/img]

[h2]Hi everyone![/h2]

Thank you all for testing out ImmersiX and for giving us your feedback so far!

Some of you may have noticed that we have continuously been improving certain aspects within our app – here’s a quick breakdown of the latest update!

1. We have made some improvements to our player, in an effort to maximise the frame compression and amplify the quality of our existing content.

2. We have improved most of the background images in “Introduction to V-Nova PresenZ”, which include:
    Brand new images.
    Upscaled and updated existing images.

3. We have re-compressed some of the scenes in “Introduction to V-Nova PresenZ” to maximise their quality.

4. Due to the MetaQuest update causing an error with the colours within the app, we have improved our XR swapchain format selection to combat the issue.

Thank you for the support so far! We’re working hard to get some new content out for you guys soon. 

- V-Nova Studios

notes.title: New visual and performance update and Sharkarma sneak peak!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey everyone![/b][/h3]

We have just implemented a new update into ImmersiX, improving the visual quality of some shots near the beginning of "ImmersiX Introduction" and introducing some minor changes to the player, mainly to address stability and performance.

Since we launched in early access in December, the team has been super busy working on new content and additions (more details on all of this soon!)

In the meantime, we have some brand new screenshots on the Steam page of the first cinematic-grade CG short film created exclusively for 6DoF VR, Sharkarma, which arrives on ImmersiX this year!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329603/00fde1383d23b8d545f4b1a823b6e0e588747b14.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329603/bc00e9b3d3aa7bd9eac30d9bd7bce6adff98cfee.jpg[/img]

Thanks again to everyone who has added ImmersiX to their library and shared feedback and suggestions. We appreciate all of your reviews and feedback as we work on new content and improvements to the overall experience during Early Access.

Stay tuned for more news and content as we have several exciting new additions coming this year!

V-Nova Studios

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2771480/ImmersiX__Sharkarma_Part_1/
